title: Anonymous hard-drive retailer stimulus (CXL image-size research): product image size (win)
company: Anonymous hard-drive retailer stimulus (CXL image-size research)

change.control: Smaller hard-drive product image, with prices removed.
change.variant: Enlarge the same hard-drive product image on the otherwise equivalent PDP.

quote: respondents perceived the product page containing the larger image to be 11$ more valuable
notes: Bargain-question difference $11; too-expensive threshold $15 higher, p=0.053. Intro summarizes $13.50 across the questions; no relative percent lift published. US general-population survey; 2,982 participants across all eight treatments, not a count for this comparison. No sales or conversion effect measured.
